_about: FOLIAGE v1 (laneFOLIAGE, STAGED DARK, UNPROVEN IN UNITY). Read by Foliage.cs (Assets\Scripts\Vis). enabled false = nothing runs, nothing loaded. Crossed-card clumps (alpha CLIP, no blend) from the ENV2D foliage PNGs, one shared mesh + one shared material per variant, no shadows. Rows come from laneFOLIAGE\gen_foliage.py (clusters of 3-7, never rows, clear of boss arena + avoidPadM, lane core, prop footprints); y is snapped by a down ray at spawn (zone yExpect +- yTolM, else dropped). Harness arg -foliage:0|1 overrides enabled. tell:true clumps are the S1 reed twitch tell (Foliage.FindTell / Foliage.Twitch).
